title: Introduction to Mahjong  -lunch & Learn
description: Join Toby  & Cindy for an intro to Mahjong during your lunch hour(s)This workshop is a two class commitment to gain the knowledge to play in your own group.  All materials provided including the 2026 Mahjong Card.  $100 pp for two classes. 11/4 & 11/18 Class is limited to 12 people.

title: Make your Own Holiday  Pottery Ornament
description: Join Casey from Sunshine ln Pottery and hand make your personalize glazed pottery Ornaments. You will learn the basics of pottery textures and glazes. Once you have created your one of kind ornaments, they will be double glazed and returned to the shop for pick up at your convenience.  $65pp

title: Live on Lang: Music in the Backyard
description: Join us Saturday, November 14 for a cozy fall night of live music at The House on Lang in Orlando, featuring Emily June, Hannah Stokes, and Sofia Camille. Beer and wine available for purchase!

title: Winter Arc Wellness
description:
Winter Arc Wellness is more than just a workout. It's an opportunity to show up for yourself, meet new people, try something different, and enjoy a little time just for YOU. 
$35pp includes fitness & matcha or coffee from kelebekdelights

title: Mahjong Monday-Guided Play
description: Already know Mahjong, come play to level up or play with friends during guided play.  Game sets provided. Bring your Mahjong card. $25 pp.  Drink specials available for purchase.

title: Pressed Flowers Artwork
description: Create your own stunning Dried Flower Art  to elevate your home decor with Pamela @BombBlooms. Great gift idea $65 pp All supplies included. Beer Wine & seltzers available for sale!

title: Pet Portrait Watercolor Class
description:
Create a hand painted portrait of your pet! 

WHAT’S INCLUDED
All materials needed for the class are included:
• Hand-sketched outline of your pet• High-quality watercolor board• Curated paint palette and Brushes
• Watercolor guide and 1 on 1 instruction

$85pp

title: Bake Club
description: Our sweetest day of the month! Bake Club is so much fun. Every attendee must bring something! No store bought baked good, please!

title: Backyard Yoga
description: Join us for a special Sunday morning of yoga, coffee, and community! Sunday, November 22nd at 11 AM at The House on Lang, we are hosting a special outdoor Gratitude Flow as we move, breathe, and take a moment to slow down and reflect on all we have to be thankful for.

title: Full Moon Yoga in Backyard
description: We will Celebrate the full moon on October 22nd. Bring water, mat and towel. Arrive early and shop! Always a special for Yogis on Full Moon night! Any Purchase in the Shop, and Maddie will discount next month's Yoga!   $15pp For more info Follow @maddieplocklear

title: Silk Scarf Custom Dying
description: Back by popular demand, learn the delicate art of naturally dying and designing your own silk scarf.  Class includes all materials and instruction by Shalini, a well known silk artist. $$60pp. makes a great gift!

title: Sourdough Starter Workshop
description: Create your own sourdough starter while learning the basics of sourdough baking in this beginner-friendly, hands-on workshop. You’ll build a sourdough starter from scratch, explore the basics of fermentation, and create your own sourdough loaf to bake at home. $40
